items.title: As France battles unprecedented wildfires, Caroit urges collective global action on climate change
items.description: Delano D'Souza is pleased to welcome French Deputy Foreign Affairs Minister Éléonore Caroit. She frames France's response to unprecedented heatwaves and wildfires through three lenses: crisis management, international solidarity, and climate governance. Caroit distinguishes between the immediate demands of emergency response and the longer term structural challenges posed by climate change, including adaptation, infrastructure resilience, and urban planning. While arguing that governments must continually strengthen preparedness and invest in prevention and adaptation, she maintains that domestic policy must be matched by sustained international climate cooperation, making collective global engagement an essential component of both disaster response and long term climate resilience.

items.title: The federalism that promotes productivity (1), By Dipo Baruwa
items.description: Development does not begin with money alone. It begins with the allocation of authority and responsibility. Authority creates the space for action.
